facts.fact: The deal record of the MOU signed on 15 December 2025 states that the US Department of State plans US$83,072,079 for Mozambique's health data systems over 2026-2030 (US$16,666,385 in 2026, US$28,230,116 in 2027), money that builds SIS-RME alongside SIS-LAB, eVIDR, nSIMAM, a health data exchange and a data warehouse; the status is pipeline and the MOU is non-binding.

The deal record quotes MOU section 2.5.1 that US-funded data systems, SIS-RME among them, are expected to be fully led and owned by the Government of Mozambique with US technical assistance and workplan oversight, as signed on 15 December 2025.

systems.owner: US-built; to Mozambican management by 20 June 2026
